$comment: The GitHub Actions every generated workflow uses, by a short name: the templates write {{action:<name>}}, a build's step "uses": "<name>". Each is pinned by its full commit SHA (a tag can be moved to other code), its release after ' # ' (a YAML comment the uses: line keeps; Dependabot updates both). Upgrading one here upgrades it in every workflow (then .\infra\generate.ps1): find the release, take its commit with gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/git/ref/tags/<tag> (type tag = annotated: gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/git/tags/<sha> gives the commit), write <owner>/<repo>@<40-char sha> # <tag>. Checked 2026-11-20: SHAs of the major tags' current releases; all on Node 24 (static-web-apps-deploy: Docker).
